purpose: Test the definitions, the multi-model representation and the real human time before the schema is frozen. Chosen for heterogeneity, not convenience.

papers.why: refining, 2025 — the sector-priority head; tests C5 boundary correspondence on a refinery utility system

cement; the heteroscedasticity case. Tests claim_status: is the statement a textbook definition (general) or a finding about this model?

multi-model papers produce one models[] entry per model with no field bleeding between them
reviewer records actual minutes per paper for the blind-first core estimate
